name: Dynamic thresholds in Activator rules
description: Adds support for dynamic thresholding in Activator rules, enabling users to define conditions based on changing baselines rather than static values. Use this enhancement when threshold limits vary across objects or can change over time. Example scenarios include:  - Buildings with different maximum allowed temperatures.  - Equipment fleets where each asset has a unique operating limit.  - Customer-level alerting where each customer has a configured threshold.
